input.quote: 7.7 If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
input.rationale: Section 7.7 imposes liquidated damages payable by Customer, which fails the preferred position (no Customer-payable LDs or penalties) and cannot be brought within the fallback (an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees) because it is a payment-delay charge, not a termination fee. At fifteen percent of annual Fees per week it is triggered by a minor breach (a ten-day payment delay) and would exceed the remaining contract value within roughly seven weeks — squarely in walk-away territory. Termination (Sections 9.4 and 10) contains no Customer-payable minimum or early-termination sums, and no other Customer-payable LD appears in the document; the SLA credits running to us are beneficial and are not flagged. Redline replaces the LD with simple interest on undisputed overdue amounts, preserving Vendor's remedy and remaining consistent with the interest reference in Section 7.3.

proposal.summary: Remove Customer-payable liquidated damages for late payment; replace with simple interest on undisputed overdue amounts
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by us, and 15% of annual Fees per week of delay would quickly exceed the contract value for a minor payment delay. We have replaced it with simple interest on undisputed overdue amounts, which preserves Vendor's remedy and is consistent with the interest reference in Section 7.3.

ops.oldText: 7.7 If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
ops.newText: 7.7 If a proper, undisputed invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Vendor's sole remedy is simple interest on the overdue amount at the lesser of one percent per month and the maximum rate permitted by Applicable Law, accruing from the due date until paid. No liquidated damages or penalty is payable by Customer under this Agreement.
